messages.subject: Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear James,

White Buffalo Consultants' work across energy and infrastructure talent makes this a relevant introduction for senior leadership mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications, with exposure to renewable-energy, battery-storage and infrastructure investment.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where energy and infrastructure growth depends on regulatory credibility, institutional relationships, stakeholder confidence and responsible development. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for global mandates.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
